references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses to make crossbars of acacia wood for the tabernacle's planks. Exodus 36:31 describes the execution of this command.
Continuation of the description of the crossbars, detailing the bars for the other sides of the tabernacle and how they were overlaid with gold.
The people's offering of acacia wood used in the construction of the tabernacle, including the crossbars mentioned in 36:31.
Description of the planks of the tabernacle that the crossbars were meant to hold together.
This verse shows the original instruction that was followed exactly in its execution.
Completes the picture by showing the instruction for the remaining sides, which the source verse describes only partially.
